steps.en: PLUS asks OCMS to put a permanent suspension on a paid notice
steps.id: PLUS meminta OCMS menaruh suspension permanen pada notice yang sudah dibayar

steps.en: PLUS gets a message that the permanent suspension worked
steps.id: PLUS menerima pesan bahwa suspension permanen berhasil

steps.en: The message tells PLUS that a refund advice was created
steps.id: Pesan memberi tahu PLUS bahwa refund advice sudah dibuat
steps.why_en: Only the apply path returns the refund ID, a related defect is still open, and revival returns none.
steps.why_id: Hanya jalur apply yang mengembalikan ID refund, defect terkait masih terbuka, dan jalur revival tidak mengembalikannya.

steps.en: The message also tells PLUS how the refund will be paid
steps.id: Pesan juga memberi tahu PLUS lewat cara apa refund dibayar
steps.why_en: The message has no refund mode; PLUS must fetch the original payment mode in a separate call.
steps.why_id: Pesan tidak memuat refund mode; PLUS harus mengambil mode pembayaran awal lewat panggilan terpisah.
